test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He always says to me, “I am perturbed.”

options.text: He always tells me that he is mostly perturbed.
He always tells me that he is perturbed.
He always tells me that he is perturbed by change
He always tells me that he is going to be perturbed.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He always tells me that he is perturbed.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"He always says to me" becomes "He always tells me"**
 
 
• Reporting verb "says to" is changed to "tells" to match indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"I am perturbed" becomes "he is perturbed"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject of the reporting verb.
 
• Verb "am" is changed to "is" to match the third person singular.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Indirect speech is not enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• The sentence structure changes to a statement format.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He always tells me that he is perturbed."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He always tells me that he is mostly perturbed." 

 
 
• The word "mostly" is added, which changes the meaning of the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He always tells me that he is perturbed by change." 
 
 
• The phrase "by change" is added, which changes the context of the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He always tells me that he is going to be perturbed." 
 
 
• The phrase "going to be" changes the tense and meaning of the original sentence.
